response.overview: It is the year 2084 and seven people who have been doing routine work underground find themselves imprisoned in a white room. Not knowing each other and alienating the situation, the room begins to play with these people, with the aim of making them Estonians. The experiment is conducted by an android scientist who inserts bits of information into the people in the room at his discretion: historical memories, language, culture and physical trials. Through the unknown situation and common trials, the unity and togetherness of the human group grows, they become ‘Estonians’. Thanks to the emergence of independent thinking and a desire for freedom, they fight to free themselves from captivity.
response.title: 2084: Memory spasms
